Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** College Navigator - Colorado State University-Fort Collins – https://nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator/?id=126818  

**Evidence**

| Attribute | Value | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| School name | Colorado State University‑Fort Collins | “Colorado State University‑Fort Collins” heading |
| Institution type | 4‑year, Public | “Type: 4‑year, Public” |
| Student‑to‑faculty ratio | 17 to 1 | “Student‑to‑faculty ratio:17 to 1” |
| On‑campus housing | Yes | “Campus housing:Yes” |
| Programs offered | Bachelor’s, Postbaccalaureate certificate, Master’s degree, Doctor’s degree – research/scholarship, Doctor’s degree – professional practice | “Awards offered: …” |
| Social Work program | Master’s (73 students), Doctor’s (3 students) | In the Programs/Majors table: “Social Work” row shows “Master 73”, “Doctor 3” |
| Tuition & Fees – In‑state (2022‑2023) | $12,874 | “In‑state $12,874” in the Tuition & Fees section |
| Tuition & Fees – Out‑of‑state (2022‑2023) | $32,734 | “Out‑of‑state $32,734” in the Tuition & Fees section |
| Student population | 34,096 | “Student population:34,096” (26,221 undergraduate) |
| Ranking of Social Work in Master/Doctor level | 73 (Master) / 3 (Doctor) | same as above |

**Missing**

| Field | Status |
|-------|--------|
| Student‑to‑faculty ratio ≤ 15 | Not satisfied (ratio 17:1) |
| Sticker price for tuition (as defined by Tuitiontracker.org) | Not available on this page |
| Confirmation of “advanced award levels” (MSW or higher) | Inferred from presence of Master’s and Doctor’s degrees in Social Work program, but explicit designation “advanced award level” not present |
| On‑campus housing details for graduate students | Not detailed beyond general “Campus housing: Yes” |
